hook: DeepMind is replacing supercomputer weather models with pure AI.
spoken_script: DeepMind is replacing supercomputer weather models with pure AI. Google DeepMind launched WeatherNext 3, predicting global weather directly from raw satellite streams. Traditional numerical simulations take six hours on supercomputers. WeatherNext 3 generates an entire ten-day global forecast at five-kilometer resolution in under sixty seconds. It tracks hurricane paths with twenty-four percent higher precision. Follow AI News Factory for daily verified AI breakthroughs.
